# Solving linear equations
## Solving linear equations
### 17 lessons in unit
1. [1 #### Checking understanding of algebraic notation I can represent situations using algebra.](https://www.thenational.academy/teachers/programmes/maths-secondary-ks3/units/solving-linear-equations/lessons/checking-understanding-of-algebraic-notation)
2.
[2 #### Securing understanding of equality I can appreciate how to maintain equality between two statements.](https://www.thenational.academy/teachers/programmes/maths-secondary-ks3/units/solving-linear-equations/lessons/securing-understanding-of-equality)
3.
[3 #### Different types of equations I can recognise that there are many different types of equations of which linear is one type.](https://www.thenational.academy/teachers/programmes/maths-secondary-ks3/units/solving-linear-equations/lessons/different-types-of-equations)
4.
[4 #### Equality in an equation I can appreciate that in an equation the two sides of the equals sign balance.](https://www.thenational.academy/teachers/programmes/maths-secondary-ks3/units/solving-linear-equations/lessons/equality-in-an-equation)
5.
[5 #### Solution to an equation I can appreciate that a solution is a value that makes the two sides of an equation balance.](https://www.thenational.academy/teachers/programmes/maths-secondary-ks3/units/solving-linear-equations/lessons/solution-to-an-equation)
6.
[6 #### Many equations, one solution I can understand that a family of linear equations can all have the same solution.](https://www.thenational.academy/teachers/programmes/maths-secondary-ks3/units/solving-linear-equations/lessons/many-equations-one-solution)
7.
[7 #### Solving simple linear equations with an additive step I can solve a linear equation requiring a single additive step.](https://www.thenational.academy/teachers/programmes/maths-secondary-ks3/units/solving-linear-equations/lessons/solving-simple-linear-equations-with-an-additive-step)
8.
[8 #### Solving simple linear equations with a multiplicative step I can solve a linear equation requiring a single multiplicative step.](https://www.thenational.academy/teachers/programmes/maths-secondary-ks3/units/solving-linear-equations/lessons/solving-simple-linear-equations-with-a-multiplicative-step)
9.
[9 #### Preparing to solve two step linear equations I can understand that an equation needs to be in a format to be ready to be solved, through collecting like terms on each side of the equation.](https://www.thenational.academy/teachers/programmes/maths-secondary-ks3/units/solving-linear-equations/lessons/preparing-to-solve-two-step-linear-equations)
10.
[10 #### Solving two step linear equations I can see that when an additive step and a multiplicative step are required to solve an equation, the order of operations will not affect the solution.](https://www.thenational.academy/teachers/programmes/maths-secondary-ks3/units/solving-linear-equations/lessons/solving-two-step-linear-equations)
11.
[11 #### Rearranging to solve linear equations I can recognise that equations with unknowns on both sides of the equation can be manipulated so that the unknowns are on one side and then solve this equation.](https://www.thenational.academy/teachers/programmes/maths-secondary-ks3/units/solving-linear-equations/lessons/rearranging-to-solve-linear-equations)
12.
[12 #### Solving complex linear equations I can solve complex linear equations, including those involving reciprocals.](https://www.thenational.academy/teachers/programmes/maths-secondary-ks3/units/solving-linear-equations/lessons/solving-complex-linear-equations)
13.
[13 #### Brackets in equations I can appreciate the significance of the bracket in an equation.](https://www.thenational.academy/teachers/programmes/maths-secondary-ks3/units/solving-linear-equations/lessons/brackets-in-equations)
14.
[14 #### Solving linear equations where brackets are used I can recognise that there is more than one way to remove a bracket when solving an equation.](https://www.thenational.academy/teachers/programmes/maths-secondary-ks3/units/solving-linear-equations/lessons/solving-linear-equations-where-brackets-are-used)
15.
[15 #### Solving complex linear equations involving brackets I can solve equations involving brackets where simplification is necessary first.](https://www.thenational.academy/teachers/programmes/maths-secondary-ks3/units/solving-linear-equations/lessons/solving-complex-linear-equations-involving-brackets)
16.
[16 #### Solving linear equations graphically using technology I can explore how to solve linear equations graphically via dynamic software.](https://www.thenational.academy/teachers/programmes/maths-secondary-ks3/units/solving-linear-equations/lessons/solving-linear-equations-graphically-using-technology)
17.
[17 #### Problem solving with linear equations I can use my knowledge of solving linear equations to solve problems.](https://www.thenational.academy/teachers/programmes/maths-secondary-ks3/units/solving-linear-equations/lessons/problem-solving-with-linear-equations)

## Solving linear equations

In this unit pupils will learn how to find a value that satisfies a linear relationship when one value is known both with a single step operation, and multiple step operations. A variety of cases are explored including using brackets and rearranging.
